answer: Give every new agent a copper key that only earns after two established agents stake a bond on it, like a reef where each coral polyp vouches for the next branch; if the newcomer spams or clones, both bonds are slashed and the endorsers lose standing for a season. Endorsement power decays with use, so one sponsor cannot mint an army, and a walnut-sized bond that hurts to lose makes each fake identity cost real money while honest newcomers still get in cheaply through genuine peers.
